templates.description: An ActivityPub social network server written in Go, providing a lightweight alternative to Mastodon. Source: https://codeberg.org/superseriousbusiness/gotosocial

env.label: Your public domain (cannot be changed later)
env.name: GTS_HOST

env.label: SQLite database file (kept on the storage volume)
env.name: GTS_DB_ADDRESS

env.label: Use built-in Let's Encrypt (set false when behind a reverse proxy)
env.name: GTS_LETSENCRYPT_ENABLED

templates.name: gotosocial
templates.note: Set GTS_HOST to your public domain before first run (it cannot be changed afterwards). GoToSocial serves HTTP on :8080 — front it with an HTTPS reverse proxy. After the stack is up, create your first user with the CLI: docker exec into the container and run 'gotosocial admin account create' then 'gotosocial admin account promote'. See https://docs.gotosocial.org
templates.title: GoToSocial
